title: Div and Span Elements
description: The <div> and <span> elements are generic containers used to organize content within a webpage.
The <div> element is a block-level container that groups larger sections of content, while the <span> element is an inline container used for smaller portions of text or content.
These elements are commonly used with CSS and JavaScript to style, organize, and manipulate webpage elements.

example.output: A section containing student information and highlighted inline text.
